notes: Fixed not hearing yourself: after a reload the mic now opens on your first click, and In your ears shows a live meter or a Start my mic button.
New On my mic now bar: see every effect on your voice in order. Click one to switch it off, x to take it off, or Clear all.
Exports are now 24-bit WAV at your recording rate for studio quality.
Track names and volume no longer overlap. Studio sections have clear Hide and Open headers, and the track panel can be hidden.
New button shapes: Pill, Soft, Leaf or Square in Appearance. Pill is the new default.
New Find and fix my static button in Mic setup: stay quiet 3 seconds and it finds hiss, hum, Bluetooth mics, red levels and crackles, then fixes what it can.
New Hum remover for electric buzz, and Audio mode: Smooth for fewer crackles with effects. Smooth is now the default.
Noise remover no longer makes a watery, chirpy static. Recording uses less computer power.
Full studio now opens in the new Producer layout: folders on the left, timeline in the middle, track panel on the right, mixer at the bottom, all on one screen.
Switch back to the old stacked look with Layout: Classic at the top of the Full studio.
SHELOOPS now updates itself. When a new version is out, it loads every new file and reloads once.
Updates now show up right away. No more waiting for an old saved copy to expire.
DJ booth visuals now fill the whole width on big screens.
The Full studio button in Guided mode now says Folders + mixer so the new layout is easy to find.
Full studio has a folder browser on the left: this song, recorded takes, my sounds by folder, and my songs. Drag anything onto the timeline.
New mixer strip under the timeline with a fader, pan, mute and solo for every track.
Add audio now explains which links work, which do not, and what to do if a link is blocked
Pop-up windows fit the screen with no sideways scrolling
Custom text colors stay readable
Paste a link works better: Google Drive, Dropbox and GitHub share links, press Enter to use it, and clear messages when a site blocks it
Echo and space controls: echo amount, how many repeats, echo speed, room amount and room size, plus one-click Dry, Just a little, Big echo and Endless
New Guided Studio: check your mic, record, make it sound good, then listen and save, one step at a time
Test your mic with a 5 second recording, plain or with your vocal style
Smoother mic gate, no more chopped words
Squeal shield is gentler and fully adjustable, and Fix my squeal keeps your effects on
Pick what you hear while recording: nothing, plain voice, or voice + effects
Easier to read colors, themed scrollbars, and page tips fold away after you have seen them
Home shows your song as a spinning CD with your own picture printed on it. Click it to change the picture (GIFs keep moving).
Beat maker has a big Record button and tells you what is happening
Play keys as chords, arpeggios, strums, octaves, with Hold and human feel
Quick sounds and effects are in scrollable groups, and stacked effects never get cut off
8 metronome click sounds
44 more voice presets and 12 more instruments
Sample maker and Tag maker have many more settings, several sounds at once, and repeat play
Change your own shortcut keys, and R no longer jumps out of the Beat maker
Squeal shield keeps hearing yourself safe, even with effects, plus a Fix my squeal button
What I hear is now a clear sound path
New Sample maker: chop songs you own, and make your producer tag
20 new beat styles in packs
Clearer pad editor, regrouped Studio tools, bolder text, smoother 3D
Real 3D CD cases, discs, MiniDisc, CD book and case stack with mouse wheel zoom
Paper types for your art, tray and plastic options, MiniDisc label pictures, GIFs and words
GIF export, design files, sticker finishes
Cursor effects no longer get stuck, plus new cursors, trails and clicks
New animated intro and clearer theme colors
New styles: G-Funk, Island Soul, Bedroom Indie, Shoegaze Metal, Guitar Rap, 4AM

Found the noise: the warm saturation, tape and exciter effects were turning quiet sounds (room hiss, fans, speaker bleed) up by as much as 4 times each. They now leave quiet sounds alone and only color your voice.
New vocal tracks have a gentle room gate on, so background noise goes quiet between your words.

What I hear now has 3 tabs. Parts: turn anything on or off. Sound safety: silence the room between words on every vocal, all vocal effects on or off, hear-myself controls, feedback guard, master volume and a Stop all sound button. Find the noise: checks your setup and tells you the most likely cause.
Checked all 182 presets and every effect: none of them keeps building or ringing on its own.

New Mic sound panel (🎙 Mic sound in the Studio toolbar, and on the Mic setup page): live level meter, room noise reading, low cut, room noise remover, a gate that sets itself (Measure my room), and a mic EQ with presets like Close to the mic, Laptop or phone mic, and Noisy room.
Feedback guard: hears the high squeal and cuts exactly that pitch, and turns your monitor down for a moment. On by default.
Hearing yourself: monitor volume, with effects or dry (safer on speakers), and an I am on speakers mode that turns on echo cancelling.
Your mic is cleaned before it is recorded, and recordings stay in time even with the noise remover on.

Home rebuilt: it no longer repeats. A tabbed welcome (Make it yours, Simple or Advanced, Start a style, Lettering), Your song step by step (a path that lights up as you finish each step and tells you where to go next), and Explore everything by category, revealed as you scroll.
Choose the font for every title (12 lettering styles), and titles now float with scattered letters.
New animated SHELOOPS runner logo. Switch back to your own picture or GIF in Appearance.
GIFs now move on cover art, on the CD player disc, on DJ record labels, and as your logo or background.
DJ visuals: 6 space looks (Hyperspace, Nebula, Galaxy, Planet, Black hole, Dancers) and a space backdrop with twinkling stars behind any look. Live buttons sit right under the visuals.
DJ sampler organized into Hype and FX rows with colored pads, and hover-to-hear when picking sounds.
Fixed: changing the feel (Calm studio, Party and so on) no longer makes scrolling text race or crawl.
New sounds: Get Lost and Starlight Pop starters, crystal bell and star pluck instruments, and Lost in Space, Starlight, Dance Floor Echo and Stargazer voice effects.

Move everything: hover any big section and drag its grip to put it where you want, or fold it away. Works in the Studio, the vocal presets, the Pad machine and the DJ booth. Reset layout puts it back.

What I hear: a switchboard in the top bar (or Shift + H) to turn any part on or off while you work: your beat file, vocals, the beat maker and each instrument, the click, the pad loop and the DJ decks.
Vocal presets organized: a sidebar with Vocal styles (rap, R&B, pop, club and world, rock and live, speech), Enhance and Voice FX by mood, favorites, your folders, and search.
172 presets now: 46 vocal styles, 42 Enhance and 84 Voice FX, including a new Healing mood. 5 new effects: Exciter, Shimmer reverb, Tape machine, Trance gate and Auto-pan.

DJ visuals: the lights are replaced by liquid metal, light orbs, flow fields, silk ribbons, kaleidoscope, plasma, aurora and a warp tunnel. Two layers, palettes, 3D camera angles, trails and glow, Live Flash, Warp, Invert and Freeze, and Auto VJ.
Healing house: dream pad, supersaw, glass keys and warm pluck instruments, Healing House, Ambient Breaks and Euphoric Trance starters, and Healing wash, Soft focus and Euphoric gate quick sounds.
Make it yours: 24 themes, make your own palette from 3 colors, and Style effects for glow, motion, pulsing and flashing, with one-click combos.
Quick tour banners on each page: hover a step and the button it talks about lights up.
Drop anywhere: drag audio files onto any page and a dock slides up. Let go on Studio (rap or sing over it), DJ deck A or B, a pad, or My sounds.
New + Audio button at the top: pick audio from your device or paste a direct link to an MP3 or WAV, then choose where it goes.
Dropping audio on empty space now opens the chooser instead of playing the file in the browser.
Fixed: the cover art editor was squashed into a thin strip. DJ booth and pad machine styles no longer touch other pages.
Fixed: beat maker pattern buttons, the Studio time display and a Studio button are back to their normal look.

DJ booth remastered: a real club light rig with haze, volumetric beams from moving heads, lasers, an LED wall visualizer, blinders, strobe, fog and floor reflections, all on the beat. Full screen light show.
Light desk: 12 scenes, 8 movements, beat-synced speed, fixtures, spread, beam width, haze, bloom, grain, 6 laser shows, 6 LED wall shows, color change timing, and an Auto show.
Realistic decks: turntables with aluminium platters, strobe dots, tonearm and real vinyl (black, colored, clear, splatter, picture disc), or CDJs with a screen in the jog wheel.
Club mixer: Color FX knob per channel (Filter, Space, Dub echo, Noise, Crush) and a Beat FX unit with 12 effects, beat timing and A, B or master. 8-pad sampler.
Deck tricks: beat jump, reverse, vinyl brake, spinback, half to 16 beat loops. 10 transitions now include Roll out and Noise sweep.
Booth materials: matte black, brushed aluminium, studio white, carbon, walnut and smoked glass, plus your own LED color and keys.
New top menu: pages grouped into Create, Finish, Design, Library and Help, each explaining what it is for. Glowing labels, animated menus, and a Simple or Advanced explainer.
New DJ booth: two turntables you can scratch, with play, cue, sync, tempo, nudge, 4 hot cues, beat loops and a scrolling waveform.
Mixer with gain, High, Mid and Low EQ with kills, a one-knob filter, channel faders with meters, and a crossfader with smooth, linear or sharp curves.
An effect on each deck, timed to the beat: echo, reverb, flanger, phaser, lo-fi, stutter, auto filter, distortion, vinyl dust and wobble.
9 one-click transitions: Smooth blend, Bass swap, Filter fade, Echo out, Reverb wash, Spinback, Vinyl brake, Stutter cut and Quick cut, from 2 to 32 beats.
Drag and drop music from your device, your Studio song, or your loops and pad loops onto a deck.
Light show and visualizer: beams, sweep, pulse and chase lights, 6 visualizers, and a strobe.
Customize the booth: vinyl or CDJ decks, body color, record and label colors, your own art on the labels, glow and light colors, beams, speed, tempo range, and your own keys.
Record your mix and save it to My sounds, or download WAV or MP3.
Pad machine loops: every bank keeps as many loops as you want. Click a loop to switch, even while it plays. New, Copy, Rename and Delete.
Safe record: recording over a loop makes a new take, then you choose Keep new, Go back to old, or Keep both. Your good loop is never lost.
Play all in order plays your loops one after another like a song, and Save loop to My sounds saves them all together.
Record voice loop: sing or rap over your beat. It records exactly one loop long, stays in time, and lands on a pad where you can add effects.
Customize the machine: pad shape (square, rounded, round, hexagon), hit lights (flash, ripple, sparks), body (graphite, white, neon, see-through, wood), screen color, glow and pad size.
5 new visualizers: Spectrum, LED blocks, Orb, Particles and Halo. Hover the player to flip through them.
84 new drum sounds: 15 kicks, 15 snares, 7 claps, 9 hi-hats, 8 open hats and cymbals, 11 808s, 5 toms, 9 percs and 5 FX hits. 137 drum sounds in all.
Sounds come in styles: trap, drill, 909 house, jungle, breakcore, gabber, lo-fi, boom bap, DnB, R&B, Afro, gospel and more.
12 new genre kits under + Percussion: Trap, Drill, Boom bap, House 909, Jungle breaks, Breakcore, Drum & Bass, Lo-fi, Rave and gabber, R&B soft, Afro and Gospel.
Drum menus are now grouped by type (Kicks, Snares, 808s and so on).
Pad machine: 4 new banks (E to H) for trap and drill, jungle and breakcore, house and lo-fi, 808s and toms. Use the ◀ ▶ buttons to flip through every sound on a pad.
New Pad machine: 16 glowing pads in 4 banks with an LCD screen and LED meter. Play drums, instruments, chords, My sounds or your own voice recorded onto a pad.
Every pad has its own effects and knobs. Record loops, then save them to My sounds with effects, send them to the beat maker, or download a WAV.
Outsider house tools: Outsider House, Acid House and Rave Breaks starters, house organ, house piano, rave stab, hoover and acid bass, a House drum kit with vinyl crackle.
New effects: Filter sweep and Vinyl dust. New Quick sounds: Outsider dust, House pump, Filter sweep, Acid squelch, Warehouse.
House voice effects: Muffled Diva, Warehouse, Filter Sweep Vocal, Old Soul Sample, Underground, Late Night Radio, Fighting Demons and more. Lonely Breakcore starter.
Home now has a welcome guide: try themes and glow, pick Simple or Advanced, and start a song in any of 17 styles with one click.
New effect: Stutter repeat. Grabs a tiny slice and repeats it, for chopped glitchy vocals and drums.

New Breakcore mood in Voice FX with 16 presets: Frozen Heart, Anime Chop, Stutter Repeat, Digital Angel, Cassette Memory, Distant Signal, Pump, Glitch Angel, Whisper Haze, Crystal, Sad Robot, Hyper Bright and more.
Reverb room size now goes up to 10 seconds for frozen, endless spaces.
Player settings window: drag it by its title bar, minimize it, close it. It always fits on screen and scrolls inside.
Move the player to any corner in one click, or minimize it to a small disc. The mini visualizer starts in the bottom corner.
Simple mode explains every step: what each tab does, a 3-step guide for vocal presets, and plain words on every effect.
More presets: 30 Enhance and 50 Voice FX, with Mood filters and a Surprise me button.
Jungle, Drum and Bass, Breakcore and Heavenly Breakcore starter beats. New Jungle drum kit: break snare, ghost snare, air horn, dub siren, rewind.
Quick sounds in the beat maker effects: Breakcore crunch, Jungle break, Heavenly wash, Dub echo and more. BPM now goes up to 300.
Text glow with your own glow color, strength and text color (Appearance).
New mouse trails and click effects: comet, rainbow, music notes, bubbles, confetti, shockwave, stars, spotlight.
Music visualizer on the CD player (ring, bars, mirror, wave, dots) with glow, color and rainbow, or a visualizer-only mini player.
Keys guide: the lists no longer overlap. Each key now sits above what it does.
Bug check: all 70 instruments, 46 drum sounds, 22 effects, 74 presets and 9 starter beats tested.
Saved presets no longer carry hidden stack tags.
Auto-wah is a bit louder.
Presets now stack: one Vocal plus any Enhance and Voice FX. Take any of them off again.
Light-up rotary knobs on every effect, including Auto-Tune (new Transpose knob).
Effects in the beat maker for every drum and instrument track.
New effects: Echo, Reverb room, Lo-fi crusher, Auto-wah, Tremolo / chop, Vibrato.
More presets: 28 Vocal, 18 Enhance, 28 Voice FX.
Bolder fonts, glowing hover and animated cards.
Export window: save your song, beat, vocals or each track as WAV or MP3 with your own file name.
Save a song or everything as a .sheloops file and open it on any computer.
Play the guitar: chord pads and a fretboard you can strum, plus big drum pads.
Keys guide: press ? to see what every key does.
Over 70 instruments: orchestra, Japanese, world, folk, mallets and fun ones.
38 percussion sounds in Latin, Japanese, World, Orchestra and FX kits.
Guitar loop maker with 16 styles.
New studio look and a new intro.
First public version of SHELOOPS.
Record vocals over your own beats, with takes, punch in and Fix my voice.
Vocal presets, Auto-Tune, effects and Build my sound.
Beat maker with patterns, your own sounds and MIDI.
Mixer, mastering and MP3 export with cover art.
Cover art, CD and MiniDisc designer with a real 3D studio.
A see-through CD player that spins your disc while music plays.
Themes, backgrounds, cursors, fonts and your own logo.
Install SHELOOPS as an app, and get notified when there is an update.
